wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Here"]

def extract_desired(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    # Remove the trailing ID/value after the final delimiter.
    if " - " in text:
        text = text.rsplit(" - ", 1)[0].strip()
    # Remove an optional leading sequence number such as "1 - ".
    text = re.sub(r"^\s*\d+\s*-\s*", "", text).strip()
    return text if text else None

for row in range(2, 7):

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification output
